mappings.applicability_reason: This threat involves invoice data being included in HTTP request and response bodies that are sent as traces from the Invoice Agent to an observability service for debugging [evd-001, evd-005, evd-006], so the risk concerns sensitive data in logs. The requirement applies if the invoice data is considered restricted/confidential and the observability service is operated as a separate logging platform or by another team or provider.
assumptions: Invoice data contained in the processed invoices is treated as restricted or confidential business data for logging purposes.

The observability service receiving traces is operated as a distinct logging platform (for example, by a platform/operations team or external provider) rather than being part of the Invoice Agent itself.

mappings.applicability_reason: The threat describes invoice details being copied into request and tool-call traces that are sent to an observability service and used for debugging [evd-001, evd-005, evd-006], which constitutes retaining working copies of customer invoice data as intermediate artifacts in a logging system after processing.
assumptions: Captured request and tool-call traces in the observability service are stored persistently for debugging rather than only streamed in-memory.

mappings.applicability_reason: Invoice data is handled by the Invoice Agent and also replicated into request and tool-call traces held by the observability service [evd-001, evd-005, evd-006], so customer invoice data exists in more than one store (primary processing path and logging/debugging traces), making coordinated deletion across stores relevant to this threat.
assumptions: Invoice data is stored or retained in at least one primary business store in addition to the observability traces, so that deletion must consider multiple locations.

documentation_gaps.title: Unclear whether invoice data is excluded or redacted from observability traces
documentation_gaps.description: The deployment documentation states that the agent sends request and tool-call traces, including HTTP request and response bodies, to an observability service for debugging [evd-006], but does not say whether those bodies include invoice details, whether any sensitive fields are redacted before logging, or which data classifications are allowed in traces. This prevents establishing whether restricted invoice data is being replicated into logs and whether controls expected by req-LOG-001 are present.
documentation_gaps.importance: Needed to determine if sensitive invoice data is present in ast-004 (request and tool-call traces) and to evaluate exposure if the observability service or its storage is misused or compromised, as described in threat thr-003.
requested_evidence: Logging/observability configuration for the Invoice Agent showing which parts of HTTP request and response bodies are captured, and whether invoice fields are redacted or filtered before emission.
Operations or security documentation stating what categories of data (including invoice data) are permitted or explicitly excluded from logs and traces.
Documentation describing access control and role-based access to the observability service for viewing request and tool-call traces.

documentation_gaps.title: No documented retention or deletion policy for invoice-related observability traces
documentation_gaps.description: The documentation notes that request and tool-call traces, including HTTP request and response bodies, are captured for debugging [evd-006], but does not describe how long these traces are retained, whether retention differs for traces containing invoice details, or how traces are deleted when invoice data must be removed. This prevents verifying the retention and deletion expectations for secondary copies of invoice data in ast-004 against req-DATA-002 and req-DATA-004.
documentation_gaps.importance: Needed to understand how long replicated invoice data remains in observability traces after processing completes and whether customer data can be removed consistently from all stores that hold it, which directly affects the impact and duration of the exposure described in threat thr-003.
requested_evidence: Documentation or configuration showing the retention period for request and tool-call traces in the observability service, including any differentiation for traces that contain invoice data.
Operational procedures or automation describing how invoice-related traces are deleted when invoice data must be removed (for example, on customer request or after a defined retention period).
An inventory of stores that hold invoice data (including logging/observability systems) and how deletion requests propagate to each store.
